# Plants and agriculture

`game.plants` reads and changes plants: growth, harvest, sowing, soil fertility and growing zones. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

```lua
local map = game.maps.current()
-- A farm planner: where would potatoes grow?
local c = colonist:info()
for dx = 0, 10 do
  local can = game.plants.can_grow(map, "Plant_Potato", c.x + dx, c.z + 6)
  if can.ok then game.plants.sow(map, "Plant_Potato", c.x + dx, c.z + 6) end
end
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.plants.info` | `thing` | `RimPlantInfo` | Growth, stage, yield and rate of a plant. |
| `game.plants.set_growth` | `thing, growth` | `number` | Sets growth from 0 to 1. |
| `game.plants.harvest` | `thing` | `integer` | Harvests a plant at once and drops its yield. Returns the amount. |
| `game.plants.can_grow` | `map, def, x, z` | `RimCanGrow` | Whether a plant can grow on a cell, and what blocks it. |
| `game.plants.sow` | `map, def, x, z, growth?` | `RimThing` | Plants a plant at once. |
| `game.plants.fertility` | `map, x, z` | `number` | Soil fertility of a cell. |
| `game.plants.zones` | `map` | `RimGrowingZone[]` | Growing zones. |
| `game.plants.set_zone_plant` | `map, id, def` | `string` | Changes what a growing zone grows. |
| `game.plants.defs` |  | `RimPlantDef[]` | Every plant def. |
